namespace: the immutable original account-journal namespace; its current authenticated owner follows account lifecycle
source: trusted canonical custody source: 1 managed or 2 independently linked; not supplied by the generic caller as authorization
result: Complete signed public original for AUTH/list, or a nostr-sealed manifest for atomic sends; never plaintext open results
commit: serialize with the parent journal account; first operation result commits before any success response or external send
replay: current source/identity/session must still match; matching digest/action returns the first exact bytes; changed intent conflicts
lifecycle: follows journal owner on merge and is deleted with journal/account purge or explicit fresh-proof wipe
capacity: known operations remain replayable at capacity; a new operation refuses before cryptography/publication. No unresolved receipt is silently pruned. Explicit fresh-proof wipe removes receipts with the journal.
result_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact result UTF-8 detects corrupt receipt storage
